pilot_reproducibility.interpretation: Separate repeatability comparison, not the gate reference or an estimate of pure hardware error.

interpretation: Only RMS-normalized allocation passes the frozen development mean-score gate. Its positive IR and full MUSIQ effects are modest; PickScore and crop MUSIQ regress. This is an exploratory selection outcome on eight reused development prompts.

RMS-matched uniform allocation loses IR, full/crop MUSIQ and PickScore while improving CLIP. This supports retaining allocation as a control question, not a theorem that its effect is universally beneficial.

Lag-aligned correction fails full MUSIQ despite a positive IR mean; crop MUSIQ and PickScore also decline. Timing alignment does not supply a broad development rescue of the earlier constancy correction.

Earlier eta1 constancy also passed a weak development gate before its187-prompt evaluation failed to establish improvement and regressed PickScore/crop MUSIQ. The present modest gate pass does not overturn that evidence or transfer to held-out performance.

The fresh baseline differs from the archived pilot by IR-0.031743375 and MUSIQ+0.7933421135. Same-hardware fresh pairing is therefore essential; those differences are not a calibrated noise distribution.
Gain-vector normalization is an established control, not a demonstrated new mechanism. No fresh64 confirmation, novelty, SOTA, superiority or equivalence claim follows.
limitations: Frozen sources, recorded model/config hashes, image bytes and scorer-revision receipts were checked. Large checkpoint weight shards were not rehashed or reloaded.
ImageReward checkpoint revision is matched from all four execution logs; its CSV lacks an independent per-row environment/weight receipt.
Actual SDPA kernel selection was not instrumented. Legacy image metadata names flash attention, while source policy prioritizes cuDNN with alternatives.
Leave-one-out gates and win counts are post hoc descriptive diagnostics, not the frozen selection rule or independent significance tests.
No new held-out data was read. Fresh64 non-execution is supported by the completed protocol/receipt and this audit scope, not a full account-wide job-history audit.
actions: Only this independent_review.json was written. No scheduler commands, GPU use, finalizer rerun, source edit or selection before completion.
